pullRequest.title: Quote with a coupon
pullRequest.description:
Adds `POST /orders/quote` so the checkout can show a price before the order is placed.

- `subtotal` is the price list (`keyboard` 50, `monitor` 200, `mouse` 25) times `quantity`.
- An optional `coupon`; `SAVE20` takes 20% off the subtotal. An unknown coupon is a 400.
- `total` is the subtotal minus the discount, and `charge` is what the card is charged, so it must equal `total`.

Example: 2 monitors with `SAVE20` → subtotal 400, discount 80, total 320, charge 320.

body.error: quantity must be a whole number
quantity must be a whole number

pullRequest.title: Filter orders by item
pullRequest.description:
`GET /orders?item=<name>` lists only the orders of that item, so the orders page can filter by product.

- `GET /orders?item=keyboard` returns only keyboard orders (seed: order 1).
- Without `item`, the list is unchanged.

checks: The bug answers total 52 for 2 keyboards at 50: caught; the correct PR answers 100: a described change, not flagged.

pullRequest.title: Order total
pullRequest.description:
`GET /orders/:id` also returns the order's price.

- `unitPrice` comes from the price list (`keyboard` 50, `monitor` 200, `mouse` 25).
- `total` is `unitPrice × quantity`.

Example: order 1 is 2 keyboards → unitPrice 50, total 100.

checks: The bug also refuses 10 units, which the description says is still accepted: caught; the correct PR accepts 10 and refuses 11: not flagged.

pullRequest.title: At most 10 units
pullRequest.description:
Caps an order at 10 units (warehouse limit).

- `POST /orders` with `quantity` 10 is still accepted (201).
- `quantity` 11 or more is refused with 400 `at most 10 units per order`.
